# Kyoto 5-Day Trip Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

A balanced Kyoto itinerary for **2 adults** from **2025-10-12 to 2025-10-16**, designed around temples, food markets, and one lighter walking day. Budget target of **USD 1,800 total excluding flights** is realistic with mid-range hotels, transit, and meals.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Timeline
| Day | Morning | Afternoon | Evening |
|---|---|---|---|
| Day 1 — Sun, Oct 12 | Arrive, check in, easy stroll in **Gion** | **Yasaka Shrine** and **Maruyama Park** | Dinner in **Pontocho**; early night |
| Day 2 — Mon, Oct 13 | **Kiyomizu-dera** early visit | **Ninenzaka/Sannenzaka** and **Kodai-ji** | Tea or dessert near **Gion** |
| Day 3 — Tue, Oct 14 | **Nishiki Market** breakfast crawl | **Nijo Castle** and nearby gardens | **Kamo River** walk + casual izakaya |
| Day 4 — Wed, Oct 15 | **Fushimi Inari Taisha** early | **Tofuku-ji** or Uji tea stop | Relaxed dinner and onsen-style bathhouse option |
| Day 5 — Thu, Oct 16 | **Arashiyama** bamboo grove and temple area | River lunch, souvenir shopping, departure buffer | Final Kyoto meal before leaving |

## Kyoto Day Cards
### Day 1: Gion Arrival and Soft Landing
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, rest, and keep the first hours light.
- Afternoon: Walk **Gion** and visit **Yasaka Shrine** for an easy first temple/shrine stop.
- Evening: Dine in **Pontocho** or along the Kamo River; keep it simple and close to the hotel.
- Food: Tempura set, tofu dinner, or a small kaiseki-style meal.

### Day 2: Higashiyama Temple Circuit
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Start early at **Kiyomizu-dera** before the busiest crowds.
- Afternoon: Explore **Ninenzaka** and **Sannenzaka**, then stop at **Kodai-ji**.
- Evening: Matcha dessert, yatsuhashi tasting, and a relaxed walk back through Gion.
- Food: Matcha parfait, tofu skin, and Kyoto sweets.

### Day 3: Market Day and Central Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Morning: Eat through **Nishiki Market**; go early for the best pace and freshest stalls.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning: Eat through **Nishiki Market**; go early for the best pace and freshest stalls, Kyoto, Japan
- Afternoon: Visit **Nijo Castle** for a historic, lower-effort cultural block.
- Evening: Unwind with a riverside stroll and casual dinner near **Kawaramachi**.
- Food: Tamagoyaki, grilled seafood skewers, pickles, and sake tasting.

### Day 4: Iconic Shrine + Low-Walking Afternoon
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Go early to **Fushimi Inari Taisha** and do only as much of the trail as feels comfortable.
- Afternoon: Choose a lighter option: **Tofuku-ji** gardens or a tea-focused half-day in **Uji**.
- Evening: Keep plans flexible with a calm dinner and a short recovery walk.
- Food: Uji matcha sweets, soba, or a quiet ramen stop.

### Day 5: Arashiyama Farewell
- Morning: Visit **Arashiyama Bamboo Grove** and one nearby temple such as **Tenryu-ji**.
- Afternoon: Lunch by the river, then browse souvenirs and keep time open for departure logistics.
- Evening: Final Kyoto dinner if your schedule allows; otherwise head out with a light snack.
- Food: Yuba tofu, river-view lunch, and seasonal wagashi.

## Budget Fit for 2 Adults
| Category | Planned Range | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Hotel, 4 nights | USD 700–1,000 | Mid-range central stay or boutique ryokan-lite option |
| Food & drinks | USD 350–550 | Mix of market meals, casual dinners, and one nicer meal |
| Local transit | USD 60–120 | Subway, buses, occasional taxi |
| Admissions | USD 80–160 | Temples, castle, gardens, small extras |
| Snacks, shopping, buffer | USD 150–300 | Souvenirs, matcha, flexibility |
| Total | **USD 1,340–2,130** | A comfortable target is **around USD 1,700–1,800** |
